$comment: Canonical MCP server list. NO SECRETS HERE: use ${VAR} placeholders; values live in ~/.config/engineering-os/secrets.env (outside git). Which servers are ON comes from a profile (`eos mcp use <profile>`; per tool with --tools). `enabled: false` on a server removes it from every profile; `clients` (optional) limits a server to some tools. Cursor, Claude Code and Codex load tool schemas on demand; Cline sends every enabled server's schemas with every request, so `tokens` (re-measured 2026-10-11 with tests/bench/mcp_schema_tokens.py: name + description + compact JSON inputSchema, chars/4) is what a server costs per Cline request. null = not measured (needs auth to list tools). `launcher: eos` servers start through `eos mcp run <name>`, which applies the guard (`guard`) and pins (`run`). `safe_tools` (read-only tools) are auto-approved in Cline only if you set EOS_MCP_CLINE_AUTO_APPROVE_SAFE=1 in secrets.env; default: every tool call asks.

github.notes: Read-only repos toolset. Fine-grained PAT: selected repos, read-only. In Cline it costs ~2,900 tokens per request while on: switch it on with a profile (build/review/api) when the task needs PRs/issues; `gh` CLI works too.

context7.notes: Up-to-date library docs. Reduces hallucinated APIs.

postman.notes: Minimal toolset. EU data residency: https://mcp.eu.postman.com/minimal On in the `api` profile.

figma.notes: OAuth in each client (no token stored). Desktop alternative: http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp On in the `design` profile.

playwright.notes: Browser for screenshots, a11y (axe) and UI debugging. In-memory profile (no saved logins), headless (EOS_MCP_BROWSER_HEADED=1 to watch), only localhost origins (add more with EOS_MCP_BROWSER_ORIGINS), output in .eos/state/playwright. Never approve browser_run_code_unsafe. On in the `design` and `debug-ui` profiles.

postgres.package: postgres-mcp 0.3.0 (crystaldba 'Postgres MCP Pro', MIT), dependencies hash-locked in mcp/postgres-mcp.lock.txt (mcp<2)
postgres.notes: READ-ONLY, dev/local only. `eos mcp run postgres` refuses hosts outside the allow-list (extend with EOS_MCP_PG_ALLOWED_HOSTS), forces default_transaction_read_only + statement_timeout per session and runs upstream restricted mode. Use the role from mcp/postgres-readonly-role.sql. On in the `api` and `debug` profiles.

minimal.use: default: docs lookups only (use the gh CLI for issues and PRs; cheapest Cline sessions)

build.use: implementation with GitHub MCP: docs + read issues/PRs (+~2,900 tokens per Cline request)

review.use: code review, PR work, release notes

api.use: API design, contract tests and checking queries against your local database

design.use: UX and frontend from Figma, with a browser to screenshot and run axe

debug.use: backend bugs and slow queries: read-only local Postgres (schema, EXPLAIN, index advice, health)

debug-ui.use: UI bugs, e2e and a11y authoring
